messages:
nina: Pushing a quickstart hygiene PR that merges the hello-world auth + local docker tips. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890 Can someone sanity-check the Python and TS snippets + the docker-compose.dev example?

leo: I'll take a look. Main request: document the preferred flow (env var) and an explicit dev alternative (`rdw login --dev`). Show both in each language snippet.

ash: Found a mismatch in the TS sample  the constructor call is outdated. Should be `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`. Also add a note to run the dev server with `--host 0.0.0.0` when using compose.

nina: Good catches. I updated the TS and added a small migration tip: "v3 -> v4: replace `Client(token=...)` with `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`."

leo: Tiny nit: use `.env.local` instead of `.env.dev`? Either works but it's a common convention. Maybe show both in a short aside.

nina: Added both and a compose snippet for `.env.local`. Also added a short troubleshooting bulleted line: "If you see auth errors in Docker, ensure your env file is referenced in `env_file`, not baked into the image via build `ARG`."

docs-bot: link-checker: scanned PR 4890  all links OK, 1 image needs alt text.

nina: Fixed alt text and pushed.

preview-bot: preview ready: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4890  staging site updated.

leo: LGTM  approving now.

nina: Thanks team  merging after preview passes.
